caption_L1: This is a bar graph labeled Most stolen motorcycle makes in the United States in 2019. The y-axis measures Number of thefts along linear scale of range 0 to 8,000 while the x-axis plots motorcycle make using categorical scale with American Honda Motor Co., Inc. on one end and Zhongneng MotorcycleCo., Ltd. at the other.
caption_L2L3: This shows that motorbikes from the Honda company are more likely to be stolen , next is hahaha then suzuki, harley, Kawasaki brands.  The other brands are less likely to be stolen however it does not provide context of how many are available to steal.
